messages.author: c621ac38989fbf3c
messages.subject: memory allocation error
parts:
Hi, I'm getting a memory allocation error when trying to predict this spatial gam. I'm predicting to an x/y grid with about 60,000 values. I'm running a reasonably capable 64 bit windows laptop that generally handles memory-intensive R processes well. Thanks for any help.

gam1<-brm(result~s(x,y), family=bernoulli, data=data)
grid[,5:9]<-fitted(gam1, newdata=grid, scale="response", summary=TRUE)

Error: cannot allocate vector of size 2.0 Gb

messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Re: memory allocation error
parts:
Your machine is simply running out of RAM because fitted, predict, etc. creates a Nsamples (4k by default) x Nvalues (60k) matrix, which is quite huge. Trying using a grid with less data points, or split your grid in parts and fit them together afterwards:

fi1 <- fitted(gam1, newdata=grid1, scale="response", summary=TRUE)
fi2 <- fitted(gam1, newdata=grid2, scale="response", summary=TRUE)
rbind(fi1, fi2)
